result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and deletion certification. It leaves the existing termination, payment, and work-assignment provisions intact. However, it is not fully minimal because it extends return and deletion duties beyond Company Data to all Works and Confidential Information. Drafting quality is also reduced by the duplicate subsection (c), the unqualified deletion obligation, and the potentially awkward requirement that all Works and Confidential Information be returned in machine-readable format.
